fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior is not represented as a completed sale.
Rent-free periods, concessions, seller adjustments and gross income are kept separate from passing rent.
Future rent reviews, stepped rents and tenant options are not treated as current completed facts.
Proposed surrender and branch closure are not treated as completed.
Planning, redevelopment and alternative-use potential remain subject to consents.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current registry status.
